content.title: About
content.content: Light beer is a fermented beverage made from malted barley, hops, water and yeast. It has a pale golden colour, moderate bitterness and a hop‑forward aroma with hints of fruit and grain. Typical alcohol content ranges from 4% to 5%.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Light beer is often referred to as a “lager”, although lagers can also be dark.
The first modern light beer was brewed in Bavaria in the 19th century.
Hops act as a natural preservative, extending the shelf life of the beer.
Different countries have their own traditional names for light beer: “Pilsner” in the Czech Republic, “Pale Ale” in the UK.
Light beer is usually served chilled at 4–7 °C.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: Beer provides B1, B2, B6 and folate, which are important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Beneficial polyphenols
items.content: Hops and malt contain antioxidant polyphenols that may protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: May support cardiovascular health
items.content: Moderate consumption of light beer has been linked to higher levels of “good” HDL cholesterol.

items.title: Provides minerals
items.content: Beer contains potassium, magnesium and phosphorus, essential for muscle and nerve function.

items.title: Aids digestion
items.content: Malt supplies dietary fiber that can help maintain regular bowel movements.

items.title: Alcohol content
items.content: Beer contains alcohol, so it should be consumed in moderation and avoided during pregnancy, while driving, or by people with liver disease.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: Light beer provides about 40–45 kcal per 100 ml, which can contribute to weight gain if consumed in excess.

items.title: Gluten
items.content: Barley malt contains gluten, making beer unsuitable for individuals with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Hops allergy
items.content: Rarely, some individuals may experience an allergic reaction to hops.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve light beer chilled in a 300–500 ml glass or mug. It pairs well with light snacks such as nuts, cheese, fish, grilled chicken or salads.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store beer in a dark, cool place at 7–12 °C. Once opened, reseal the bottle and consume within 2–3 days to preserve flavor and aroma.
